project.name: QH :: Product Builder (parent)
project.description: Parent/aggregator for the Product Builder domain (47 tables, one bounded context, one PRODUCTBUILDER schema/database - see README's "Domain vs Schema" section). Groups its five sub-domains as Maven sub-modules for easier management, while they still share one Java package root (ir.bank.qh.productbuilder.*) and deploy together as one persistence unit (ProductBuilderPersistenceConfig in qh-app scans "ir.bank.qh.productbuilder" as a whole).
